The '''Exar Kun mural''' was a work of art depicting the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. It was found by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] after they ventured into the [[Temple of Exar Kun]]&mdash;located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]&mdash;sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The spacers had entered the temple on a mission to destroy the [[Cult of Exar Kun]]. The final, deepest chamber of the temple featured a much larger version of the mural.

==Description==
[[File:Throne_Room.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Exar Kun's throne room]]
The center of the Exar Kun mural depicted the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] in the foreground, wielding his [[Exar Kun's lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], his body giving off a [[Color/Legends|red]] aura. The center's background depicted dark, jagged spikes with a red light shining from the top-left corner. [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] cultists cloaked in black appeared on either side of the center image, with red lightning emanating from their forms. The images were set into a dark, carved stone frame.<ref name="SWG:EKM" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The mural was discovered by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during their explorations of the [[Temple of Exar Kun]]&mdash;a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]&mdash;sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The spacers had come to the temple on a mission to destroy the [[Cult of Exar Kun]] and banish the resurrected [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] evil spirit back into the [[Chaos/Legends|Void]]. They looted the mural from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] corpse.<ref name="SWG:EK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=heroic|Exar Kun}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

A larger version of the mural hung upon the wall in Exar Kun's throne room, the deepest chamber of the temple.<ref name="SWG:EK" /><ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Throne Room}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Exar Kun mural appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EKM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Exar Kun mural was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref> It was one of the many new pieces of loot found on enemies within the Temple of Exar Kun "heroic encounter" that the patch added. This particular item was from Exar Kun, the final boss of the encounter.<ref name="SWG:EK" /> It was extremely rare and could be sold to other players for several hundred million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], depending on the server on which it was featured.<ref>{{SWGWiki|Exar Kun Mural}}</ref> It could be used in a player's personal structure as a decoration.<ref name="SWG:EKM" /> The painting also appeared as part of the artwork for the "Throne Room" card in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' expansion set ''[[Galactic Hunters]]'', released on [[March 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SWGTCG" />
